HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_FUNDAMENTALS.title: Kido Fundamentals
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_FUNDAMENTALS.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain {Chant} [gold]Chant[/gold].\nGain 1 random relic.\nBosses drop 1 additional relic.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_FUNDAMENTALS.flavor: The first step toward mastering Kido. Daily practice builds lasting strength.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_ESSENCE.title: Essence of Kido
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_ESSENCE.description:
At the start of combat, gain {Chant} [gold]Chant[/gold].
At the start of each turn after the first, gain 1 [gold]Chant[/gold].
Gain 1 random relic.
Bosses drop 1 additional relic.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_ESSENCE.flavor: Years of training reveal the essence of Kido.
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_GUARD.title: Tobiume's Guard
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_GUARD.description: At the start of combat, gain 10 [gold]Ember[/gold].
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_GUARD.flavor: A sword guard carrying the resolve to fight alongside Tobiume.
HINAMORIMOD-FLAME_TALISMAN.title: Flame Talisman
HINAMORIMOD-FLAME_TALISMAN.description: At the start of combat, apply 4 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HINAMORIMOD-FLAME_TALISMAN.flavor: A talisman containing the flames of Kido.
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_EMBER.title: Tobiume's Ember
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_EMBER.description: At the end of each turn, gain 1 [gold]Ember[/gold].
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_EMBER.flavor: A small flame continues to burn.
